source.text: הַ֥לְלוּ יָ֨הּ׀הַֽ֭לְלוּ אֶת־שֵׁ֣ם יְהוָ֑ה הַֽ֝לְלוּ עַבְדֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: Praise Yah! Praise the name of YHWH; praise, servants of YHWH,

en.L: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Praise the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; praise, servants of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}},
en.B: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Praise the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; give {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} praise, you servants of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}},
en.R: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}! Praise the name of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! All of you who serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, praise {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}!

fr.L: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Louez le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; louez, esclaves {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}},
fr.B: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Louez le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ; louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}, vous, serviteurs {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}},
fr.R: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} ! Louez le nom {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} ! Vous tous qui servez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, louez-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} !

sw.L: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Lisifuni jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; sifuni, enyi watumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}},
sw.B: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Lisifuni jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; mpeni sifa, enyi watumishi wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}},
sw.R: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}! Lisifuni jina la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Ninyi nyote mnaomtumikia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, msifuni!

decisions.choice: Praise Yah: the call Hallelu-yah
decisions.reason: The psalm opens and closes (verse 21) with Hallelu-yah, "praise Yah". Yah is the short form of the divine name (Exodus 15:2), rendered like the full name, with Yah as the alternative. Verses 3 and 4 use the short form too.

decisions.choice: the opening of Psalms 113 and 134
decisions.reason: The first lines echo 113:1 ("Praise, servants of the LORD, praise the name of the LORD") and 134:1, which also calls on the LORD's servants who stand in his house. Much of this psalm gathers lines from other parts of Scripture.

decisions.choice: servants of the LORD: those who serve at his house
alternatives: all Israel as the LORD's servants
decisions.reason: Verse 2 places them in the temple and its courts: the priests and Levites first, but verses 19-20 widen the call to all Israel and all who fear the LORD.

decisions.choice: give him praise (B); praise him (R)
decisions.reason: The third "praise" has no object in the Hebrew; Balanced and Readable supply "him", the LORD just named.

decisions.choice: "Louez le SEIGNEUR", with "Yah" under the divine-name setting, for Hallelu-yah
decisions.reason: The terms note sets this form for the call Hallelu-yah: it says what the call means, and readers who choose the name see "Louez Yah". "Alléluia", the familiar French form, would keep the sound but hide the meaning.

decisions.choice: "Msifuni BWANA" (Praise the LORD), with "Yah" under the name setting, for Hallelu Yah
decisions.reason: Hallelu Yah is a command to a group: "praise Yah". Swahili says it with the plural command "Msifuni", so the reader hears what it means; the short name Yah is shown as BWANA, with "Yah" as the setting's alternative.

source.text: שֶׁ֣֭עֹֽמְדִים בְּבֵ֣ית יְהוָ֑ה בְּ֝חַצְר֗וֹת בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: who [are] standing in [the] house of YHWH, in [the] courts of [the] house of our God.

en.L: who stand in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in the courts of the house of our God.
en.B: who stand in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in the courtyards of the house of our God.
en.R: You stand in the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, in the courtyards of our God's temple.

fr.L: qui vous tenez dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, dans les parvis de la maison de notre Dieu.
fr.B: qui vous tenez dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, dans les cours de la maison de notre Dieu.
fr.R: Vous vous tenez dans la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, dans les cours du temple de notre Dieu.

sw.L: mnaosimama katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, katika nyua za nyumba ya Mungu wetu.
sw.B: mnaosimama katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, katika viwanja vya nyumba ya Mungu wetu.
sw.R: Mnasimama katika nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, katika viwanja vya hekalu la Mungu wetu.

decisions.choice: stand: serve
decisions.reason: To stand before the LORD is the posture of those who serve him, as the Levites were set apart "to stand before the LORD to serve him" (Deuteronomy 10:8).

decisions.choice: courts: the open courtyards around the temple
decisions.reason: The courts (chatserot) were the walled open spaces around the temple building, where the worshipers gathered (84:3; 100:4).

decisions.choice: temple
decisions.reason: Readable says "temple" for the second "house", the building the courtyards surround.

source.text: הַֽ֭לְלוּ־יָהּ כִּי־ט֣וֹב יְהוָ֑ה זַמְּר֥וּ לִ֝שְׁמ֗וֹ כִּ֣י נָעִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Praise Yah, for good [is] YHWH; sing praises to his name, for [it is] pleasant.

en.L: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] good; sing praises to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, for [it is] pleasant.
en.B: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}, for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is good; make music to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, for that is a delight.
en.R: Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}, because {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is good. Sing praise to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} name, because singing to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} is a joy.

fr.L: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] bon ; chantez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, car [c’est] agréable.
fr.B: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon ; jouez pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, car c’est un bonheur.
fr.R: Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}}, parce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est bon. Chantez pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} nom, parce que c’est une joie de chanter pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mwema; imbeni sifa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, kwa maana [ni] kupendeza.
sw.B: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}, kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema; pigeni muziki kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, kwa maana hilo ni furaha.
sw.R: Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}, kwa sababu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mwema. Imbeni sifa kwa jina {{deity_pronoun:lake|Lake}}, kwa sababu kumwimbia ni furaha.

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is a shortened form of the name YHWH (as in Exodus 15:2 and in "Hallelu-yah"). It is rendered like the full name, with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: it is pleasant: singing his praise is a delight
decisions.reason: "It" may be the act of singing praise, as in 147:1 ("for it is pleasant, praise is fitting"), or the LORD's name. The parallel with 147:1 favors the singing.

decisions.choice: sing praises: make music
decisions.reason: The verb (zamar) is to sing praise, often with instruments (33:2).

decisions.choice: that is a delight (B); singing to him is a joy (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what is pleasant (m2).

source.text: כִּֽי־יַעֲקֹ֗ב בָּחַ֣ר ל֣וֹ יָ֑הּ יִ֝שְׂרָאֵ֗ל לִסְגֻלָּתֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: For Jacob has chosen for himself Yah, Israel for his treasured possession.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} has chosen Jacob for {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}, Israel for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} treasured possession.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}} chose Jacob to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own, Israel to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} special treasure.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yah}} chose the people of Jacob to belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. He chose Israel to be {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own treasure.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} a choisi Jacob pour {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, Israël pour {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} bien précieux.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} a choisi Jacob pour qu’il soit à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, Israël pour qu’il soit {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trésor.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} a choisi le peuple de Jacob pour qu’il {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartienne. Il a choisi Israël pour être {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} trésor à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} amemchagua Yakobo kwa ajili {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, Israeli kuwa milki {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} ya thamani.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} alimchagua Yakobo kuwa {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}, Israeli kuwa hazina {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} maalum.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}} aliwachagua watu wa Yakobo wawe mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. Aliwachagua Israeli wawe hazina {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} {{deity_pronoun:mwenyewe|Mwenyewe}}.

decisions.choice: Yah: the short form of the divine name
decisions.reason: Yah is a shortened form of the name YHWH (as in Exodus 15:2 and in "Hallelu-yah"). It is rendered like the full name, with Yah as the alternative.

decisions.choice: treasured possession: a king's own treasure
decisions.reason: The word (segullah) is personal treasure, set apart as one's own (1 Chronicles 29:3). The LORD calls Israel his segullah at Sinai (Exodus 19:5) and in Deuteronomy 7:6.

decisions.choice: Jacob, Israel: the people named after their ancestor
decisions.reason: Jacob, renamed Israel (Genesis 32), is the father of the twelve tribes. Both names stand for the whole people.

decisions.choice: the people of Jacob
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the nation is meant (m3).

source.text: כִּ֤י אֲנִ֣י יָ֭דַעְתִּי כִּי־גָד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וַ֝אֲדֹנֵ֗ינוּ מִכָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For I know that great [is] YHWH, and our Lord [is] above all gods.

en.L: For I know that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} [is] great, and our Lord [is] above all gods.
en.B: I am sure of it: {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is great, and our Lord stands above all gods.
en.R: I know how great {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is. Our Lord is greater than any of the gods.

fr.L: Car moi, je sais que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} [est] grand, et notre Seigneur [est] au-dessus de tous les dieux.
fr.B: J’en suis certain : {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand, et notre Seigneur est au-dessus de tous les dieux.
fr.R: Je sais combien {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est grand. Notre Seigneur est plus grand que tous les dieux.

sw.L: Kwa maana mimi ninajua kwamba {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} [ni] mkuu, na Bwana wetu [yuko] juu ya miungu yote.
sw.B: Nina hakika nalo: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu, na Bwana wetu yuko juu ya miungu yote.
sw.R: Ninajua jinsi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alivyo mkuu. Bwana wetu ni mkuu kuliko miungu yote.

decisions.choice: I know: a confession like Jethro's
decisions.reason: Jethro, hearing of the rescue from Egypt, said, "Now I know that the LORD is greater than all the gods" (Exodus 18:11). Here one voice steps out from the choir to say the same.

decisions.choice: above all gods: over every power the nations worship
decisions.reason: The psalm does not grant that the gods of the nations are real rivals: verses 15-18 call them silver and gold. The LORD is above whatever they are taken to be (95:3; 96:4-5).

decisions.choice: our Lord: the title 'Adon
decisions.reason: The word ('adon) means master or lord; it is a title, not the divine name.

decisions.choice: I am sure of it
decisions.reason: Balanced gives the emphasis of the opening "for" and "I" (the pronoun is written out in the Hebrew) with a short confession.

source.text: כֹּ֤ל אֲשֶׁר־חָפֵ֥ץ יְהוָ֗ה עָ֫שָׂ֥ה בַּשָּׁמַ֥יִם וּבָאָ֑רֶץ בַּ֝יַּמִּ֗ים וְכָל־תְּהוֹמֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: All that delights YHWH he does, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all [the] deeps.

en.L: All that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} desires {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does, in the heavens and on the earth, in the seas and all [the] deeps.
en.B: Whatever {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} chooses to do, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} does it, in the heavens, on the earth, in the seas and in all the ocean depths.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} does anything {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} wants to do, in the sky, on the earth, in the seas, and in the deepest oceans.

fr.L: Tout ce qui plaît {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le fait, dans les cieux et sur la terre, dans les mers et tous les abîmes.
fr.B: Tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} veut faire, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le fait, dans les cieux, sur la terre, dans les mers et dans toutes les profondeurs.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fait tout ce qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} veut, dans le ciel, sur la terre, dans les mers et au plus profond des océans.

sw.L: Yote ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anapenda hufanya, mbinguni na duniani, baharini na katika vilindi vyote.
sw.B: Lolote ambalo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anachagua kufanya, hulifanya, mbinguni, duniani, baharini na katika vilindi vyote vya bahari.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} hufanya lolote analotaka kufanya, angani, duniani, baharini, na katika bahari zenye kina kirefu kabisa.

decisions.choice: all that he desires he does: as in 115:3
decisions.reason: Psalm 115:3 says the same of God in heaven, against the idols that can do nothing (115:4-8, repeated here in verses 15-18).

decisions.choice: the deeps: the great waters under the earth
decisions.reason: The word (tehomot) is the deep of Genesis 1:2, the waters below the earth and the sea. Heaven, earth, seas and deeps make up the whole world, and the LORD rules all of it.

source.text: מַֽעֲלֶ֣ה נְשִׂאִים֮ מִקְצֵ֪ה הָ֫אָ֥רֶץ בְּרָקִ֣ים לַמָּטָ֣ר עָשָׂ֑ה מֽוֹצֵא־ר֝וּחַ מֵאֽוֹצְרוֹתָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: Bringing up clouds from [the] end of the earth, lightnings for the rain he makes, bringing out wind from his storehouses.

en.L: [He is] bringing up clouds from the end of the earth; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes lightning for the rain, bringing out wind from {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} storehouses.
en.B: He raises the clouds from the far edges of the earth; {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} makes lightning flash with the rain and brings the wind out of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} storehouses.
en.R: He makes clouds rise up from far away at the edge of the world. He sends lightning with the rain. He brings out the wind from the places where {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} keeps it.

fr.L: [C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui] fait monter les nuages de l’extrémité de la terre ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait les éclairs pour la pluie, faisant sortir le vent de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} réserves.
fr.B: Il fait monter les nuages des confins de la terre ; {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait jaillir l’éclair avec la pluie et tire le vent de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} réserves.
fr.R: Il fait monter les nuages de très loin, du bout du monde. Il envoie les éclairs avec la pluie. Il fait sortir le vent des endroits où {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} le garde.

sw.L: [Ndiye] anayepandisha mawingu kutoka mwisho wa dunia; hufanya umeme kwa ajili ya mvua, akitoa upepo kutoka ghala {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.B: Huyainua mawingu kutoka miisho ya dunia; hufanya umeme umulike pamoja na mvua na kuutoa upepo katika ghala {{deity_pronoun:zake|Zake}}.
sw.R: Huyafanya mawingu yapande kutoka mbali kwenye mwisho wa dunia. Hutuma umeme pamoja na mvua. Huutoa upepo kutoka mahali anapouhifadhi.

decisions.choice: the same words as Jeremiah 10:13 and 51:16
decisions.reason: This verse appears almost word for word in Jeremiah 10:13 and 51:16, in passages that also mock idols (Jeremiah 10:3-5, 14), as this psalm does in verses 15-18.

decisions.choice: his storehouses: the wind kept ready by God
decisions.reason: Wind, rain, snow and hail are pictured as kept in God's storerooms until he sends them out (Job 38:22; 33:7).

decisions.choice: lightnings for the rain: lightning with the rain
decisions.reason: The lightning goes with the storm that brings rain. The rain god of Canaan was praised for storms; here the LORD makes them.

decisions.choice: [He is]
decisions.reason: The Hebrew begins with a participle, "bringing up"; Literal supplies the subject in brackets.

source.text: שֶֽׁ֭הִכָּה בְּכוֹרֵ֣י מִצְרָ֑יִם מֵ֝אָדָ֗ם עַד־בְּהֵמָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: who struck down [the] firstborn of Egypt, from human to animal.

en.L: [It is {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}] who struck down the firstborn of Egypt, from human to animal.
en.B: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of people and of animals alike.
en.R: He killed every firstborn in Egypt, the oldest sons of the people and the firstborn of the animals.

fr.L: [C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}] qui a frappé les premiers-nés d’Égypte, de l’humain jusqu’à la bête.
fr.B: Il a frappé les premiers-nés d’Égypte, ceux des humains comme ceux des bêtes.
fr.R: Il a fait mourir tous les premiers-nés en Égypte, les fils aînés des gens et les premiers-nés des animaux.

sw.L: [Ni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}] aliyewapiga wazaliwa wa kwanza wa Misri, tangu mwanadamu hadi mnyama.
sw.B: Aliwapiga wazaliwa wa kwanza wa Misri, wa watu na wa wanyama pia.
sw.R: Aliua kila mzaliwa wa kwanza huko Misri, wana wa kwanza wa watu na wazaliwa wa kwanza wa wanyama.

decisions.choice: the death of Egypt's firstborn
decisions.reason: The last of the plagues on Egypt, from Pharaoh's son to the firstborn of the livestock (Exodus 12:29). The psalm now tells the story of the exodus and the conquest (verses 8-12), as Psalm 136 does at greater length.

decisions.choice: the oldest sons
decisions.reason: Readable explains "firstborn" for people: the firstborn son of each family (Exodus 12:29).

decisions.choice: "l'humain", "des humains", "des gens" for ʾadam set against animals, with no gender setting
decisions.reason: Here ʾadam stands against "animal", meaning people as opposed to beasts; the English has no setting either. French says "humain" plainly, which is the inclusive default the gender setting would give.

source.text: שָׁלַ֤ח׀אֹת֣וֹת וּ֭מֹפְתִים בְּתוֹכֵ֣כִי מִצְרָ֑יִם בְּ֝פַרְעֹ֗ה וּבְכָל־עֲבָדָֽיו׃

records.literal_gloss: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, on Pharaoh and on all his servants.

en.L: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, Egypt, against Pharaoh and against all his servants.
en.B: Into your very heart, Egypt, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sent signs and wonders, against Pharaoh and all his officials.
en.R: Egypt, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} did amazing things among you that showed {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} power. He did them against Pharaoh and all his officials.

fr.L: Il a envoyé des signes et des prodiges au milieu de toi, Égypte, contre Pharaon et contre tous ses esclaves.
fr.B: Au cœur même de ton pays, Égypte, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a envoyé des signes et des prodiges, contre Pharaon et tous ses ministres.
fr.R: Égypte, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a fait chez toi des choses étonnantes qui montraient {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} puissance. Il les a faites contre Pharaon et tous ses ministres.

sw.L: Alituma ishara na maajabu katikati yako, Ee Misri, juu ya Farao na juu ya watumishi wake wote.
sw.B: Katikati yako kabisa, Ee Misri, alituma ishara na maajabu, dhidi ya Farao na maafisa wake wote.
sw.R: Misri, alifanya mambo ya ajabu kati yako yaliyoonyesha uweza {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Aliyafanya dhidi ya Farao na maafisa wake wote.

decisions.choice: your midst, Egypt: the psalm turns to address Egypt
decisions.reason: For a moment the singer speaks to Egypt itself, as if it were present.

decisions.choice: signs and wonders: the plagues
decisions.reason: The pair (otot and moftim) names the plagues as acts that showed the LORD's power and purpose (Deuteronomy 6:22).

decisions.choice: his servants: Pharaoh's officials
decisions.reason: The servants of a king are his court and officials (Exodus 10:7).

decisions.choice: officials
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say who Pharaoh's servants were (m3).

decisions.choice: amazing things that showed his power
decisions.reason: Readable says what the signs and wonders were for (m2).

source.text: שֶֽׁ֭הִכָּה גּוֹיִ֣ם רַבִּ֑ים וְ֝הָרַ֗ג מְלָכִ֥ים עֲצוּמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: who struck many nations and killed mighty kings,

en.L: [It is {{deity_pronoun:he|He}}] who struck many nations and killed mighty kings,
en.B: He struck down many nations and killed powerful kings,
en.R: He defeated many nations and killed powerful kings.

fr.L: [C’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}] qui a frappé des nations nombreuses et tué des rois puissants,
fr.B: Il a frappé des nations nombreuses et tué des rois puissants,
fr.R: Il a vaincu beaucoup de nations et tué des rois puissants.

sw.L: [Ni {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}] aliyepiga mataifa mengi na kuua wafalme wenye nguvu,
sw.B: Aliyapiga mataifa mengi na kuwaua wafalme wenye nguvu,
sw.R: Aliyashinda mataifa mengi na kuwaua wafalme wenye nguvu.

decisions.choice: many nations, mighty kings: the conquest
decisions.reason: The kings Israel defeated east of the Jordan and in Canaan (Numbers 21:21-35; Joshua 12), named in verse 11.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: Verse 11 names the kings, so this verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

source.text: לְסִיח֤וֹן׀מֶ֤לֶךְ הָאֱמֹרִ֗י וּ֭לְעוֹג מֶ֣לֶךְ הַבָּשָׁ֑ן וּ֝לְכֹ֗ל מַמְלְכ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן׃

records.literal_gloss: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all [the] kingdoms of Canaan,

en.L: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,
en.B: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan,
en.R: He killed Sihon, king of the Amorites, and Og, king of Bashan. He defeated all the kingdoms in Canaan.

fr.L: Sihon, roi des Amoréens, et Og, roi de Basan, et tous les royaumes de Canaan,
fr.B: Sihon, roi des Amoréens, Og, roi de Basan, et tous les royaumes de Canaan,
fr.R: Il a tué Sihon, roi des Amoréens, et Og, roi de Basan. Il a vaincu tous les royaumes de Canaan.

sw.L: Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, na Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, na falme zote za Kanaani,
sw.B: Sihoni mfalme wa Waamori, Ogu mfalme wa Bashani, na falme zote za Kanaani,
sw.R: Alimwua Sihoni, mfalme wa Waamori, na Ogu, mfalme wa Bashani. Alizishinda falme zote za Kanaani.

decisions.choice: Sihon and Og: two kings east of the Jordan
decisions.reason: Sihon ruled the Amorites from Heshbon, and Og ruled Bashan, the high, fertile land east of the Sea of Galilee. Israel defeated both before crossing the Jordan (Numbers 21:21-35; Deuteronomy 2-3). Their defeat was remembered as the first sign that the land would be given (Joshua 2:10).

decisions.choice: to Sihon: the kings are what he killed
decisions.reason: The small word "to" before each name marks them as the ones killed (verse 10), a use found in later Hebrew.

decisions.choice: He killed ... He defeated
decisions.reason: Readable repeats the verbs of verse 10 so that each sentence stands on its own (m2).

source.text: וְנָתַ֣ן אַרְצָ֣ם נַחֲלָ֑ה נַ֝חֲלָ֗ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל עַמּֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: and he gave their land [as] an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel his people.

en.L: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave their land [as] an inheritance, an inheritance to Israel {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people.
en.B: and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave their land away as a heritage, a heritage for {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people Israel.
en.R: He gave their land to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people Israel to keep as their own.

fr.L: et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné leur pays [en] héritage, en héritage à Israël, {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple.
fr.B: et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a donné leur pays en héritage, en héritage à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple Israël.
fr.R: Il a donné leur pays à {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple Israël, pour qu’il le garde comme son bien.

sw.L: na akaitoa nchi yao [kuwa] urithi, urithi kwa Israeli watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.B: na akaitoa nchi yao kuwa urithi, urithi kwa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Israeli.
sw.R: Aliwapa watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Israeli nchi yao iwe mali yao wenyewe.

decisions.choice: inheritance: land held by a family for good
decisions.reason: An inheritance (nachalah) is land that belongs to a family and passes from parents to children. The land of Canaan was shared out to Israel's tribes in this way (Joshua 13-21).

decisions.choice: to keep as their own
decisions.reason: Readable says what an inheritance is (m1) and does not repeat the word.

source.text: יְ֭הוָה שִׁמְךָ֣ לְעוֹלָ֑ם יְ֝הוָ֗ה זִכְרְךָ֥ לְדֹר־וָדֹֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH, your name [is] forever; YHWH, your remembrance [is] to generation and generation.

en.L: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name [is] forever; {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} remembrance [is] to generation and generation.
en.B: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name will last forever; {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, people will remember {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} in every generation.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} name will last forever. People in every generation will remember {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}.

fr.L: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom [est] pour toujours ; {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} souvenir [est] de génération en génération.
fr.B: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom durera toujours ; {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, on se souviendra de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}} de génération en génération.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} nom durera toujours. Les gens de chaque génération se souviendront de {{deity_pronoun:toi|Toi}}, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} [ni] la milele; Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, ukumbusho {{deity_pronoun:wako|Wako}} [ni] kwa kizazi na kizazi.
sw.B: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} litadumu milele; Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, watu watakukumbuka katika kila kizazi.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, jina {{deity_pronoun:lako|Lako}} litadumu milele. Watu wa kila kizazi watakukumbuka, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

decisions.choice: your name, your remembrance: Exodus 3:15
decisions.reason: At the burning bush God said, "This is my name forever, and this is my remembrance from generation to generation" (Exodus 3:15). The psalm turns those words into praise; 102:13 does the same.

decisions.choice: remembrance: the name by which he is remembered
decisions.reason: The word (zekher) is what keeps someone in memory, especially the name that is called on in worship.

decisions.choice: people will remember you
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable turn the noun into a verb (m2).

source.text: כִּֽי־יָדִ֣ין יְהוָ֣ה עַמּ֑וֹ וְעַל־עֲ֝בָדָ֗יו יִתְנֶחָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: For YHWH will vindicate his people, and on his servants he will have compassion.

en.L: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will judge {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, and on {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} will have compassion.
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} will take up the cause of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people and show pity to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} will defend {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people. He will be kind and caring to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} servants.

fr.L: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} jugera {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, et de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} esclaves {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aura compassion.
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} prendra la défense de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} aura pitié de {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} défendra {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple. Il sera bon et plein de tendresse pour {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} serviteurs.

sw.L: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawahukumu watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, na juu ya watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} atakuwa na huruma.
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatetea watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} na kuwaonea huruma watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} atawatetea watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. Atakuwa mwema na kuwajali watumishi {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}.

decisions.choice: the words of Deuteronomy 32:36
decisions.reason: The verse repeats Deuteronomy 32:36, from the song of Moses. Hebrews 10:30 quotes the same line, "The Lord will judge his people", as a warning to believers.

decisions.choice: judge: do justice for, take their side
decisions.reason: The verb (din) is to judge or to plead a cause. Here, after the rescue from Egypt and the gift of the land, it means that the LORD will see justice done for his people, as in Deuteronomy 32:36.

decisions.choice: have compassion: change his mind and show pity
decisions.reason: The verb (nicham, reflexive) means to be moved to pity, or to change one's course out of pity.

decisions.choice: take up the cause of (B); defend (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the sense of the verb here (m2); Literal keeps "judge".

source.text: עֲצַבֵּ֣י הַ֭גּוֹיִם כֶּ֣סֶף וְזָהָ֑ב מַ֝עֲשֵׂ֗ה יְדֵ֣י אָדָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: [The] idols of the nations [are] silver and gold, [the] work of [the] hands of humankind.

en.L: The idols of the nations [are] silver and gold, the work of human hands.
en.B: The idols of the nations are made of silver and gold, shaped by human hands.
en.R: The idols of the nations are only silver and gold. People made them with their own hands.

fr.L: Les idoles des nations [sont] argent et or, l’œuvre des mains humaines.
fr.B: Les idoles des nations sont faites d’argent et d’or, façonnées par des mains humaines.
fr.R: Les idoles des nations ne sont que de l’argent et de l’or. Ce sont des gens qui les ont faites de leurs mains.

sw.L: Miungu ya sanamu ya mataifa [ni] fedha na dhahabu, kazi ya mikono ya binadamu.
sw.B: Sanamu za mataifa zimeundwa kwa fedha na dhahabu, zimefanyizwa kwa mikono ya binadamu.
sw.R: Sanamu za mataifa ni fedha na dhahabu tu. Watu walizitengeneza kwa mikono yao wenyewe.

decisions.choice: verses 15-18 repeat 115:4-8
decisions.reason: These verses repeat the mockery of idols in 115:4-8, with small changes: this psalm says "the idols of the nations", leaves out the lines on noses, hands, feet and throats, and adds that there is no breath in their mouths (verse 17).

decisions.choice: idols: images shaped by craftsmen
decisions.reason: The word ('atsabbim) is used for images of gods, things carved or cast. Silver and gold are what they are made of, and all they are.

decisions.choice: only silver and gold
decisions.reason: Readable brings out the scorn in the plain statement: they are nothing more than metal.

source.text: פֶּֽה־לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יְדַבֵּ֑רוּ עֵינַ֥יִם לָ֝הֶ֗ם וְלֹ֣א יִרְאֽוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: A mouth [is] to them, and not they speak; eyes [are] to them, and not they see.

en.L: They have a mouth, but they do not speak; they have eyes, but they do not see.
en.B: They have a mouth, yet say nothing; they have eyes, yet see nothing.
en.R: Idols have mouths, but they cannot talk. They have eyes, but they cannot see.

fr.L: Elles ont une bouche, mais elles ne parlent pas ; elles ont des yeux, mais elles ne voient pas.
fr.B: Elles ont une bouche, et pourtant elles ne disent rien ; elles ont des yeux, et pourtant elles ne voient rien.
fr.R: Les idoles ont une bouche, mais elles ne peuvent pas parler. Elles ont des yeux, mais elles ne peuvent pas voir.

sw.L: Kinywa zinacho, lakini hazisemi; macho zinayo, lakini hazioni.
sw.B: Zina kinywa, lakini hazitamki neno; zina macho, lakini hazioni kitu.
sw.R: Sanamu zina vinywa, lakini haziwezi kuongea. Zina macho, lakini haziwezi kuona.

decisions.choice: a mouth is to them: they have a mouth
decisions.reason: Hebrew says "to them [is] a mouth" for "they have a mouth". The idols have the shape of a mouth and eyes, but none of their use (115:5).

source.text: אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יַאֲזִ֑ינוּ אַ֝֗ף אֵין־יֶשׁ־ר֥וּחַ בְּפִיהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Ears [are] to them, and not they give ear; also there is not breath in their mouth.

en.L: They have ears, but they do not give ear; nor is there any breath in their mouth.
en.B: They have ears, yet hear nothing; there is not even breath in their mouths.
en.R: They have ears, but they cannot hear. They do not even breathe.

fr.L: Elles ont des oreilles, mais elles n’écoutent pas ; il n’y a pas non plus de souffle dans leur bouche.
fr.B: Elles ont des oreilles, et pourtant elles n’entendent rien ; il n’y a même pas de souffle dans leur bouche.
fr.R: Elles ont des oreilles, mais elles ne peuvent pas entendre. Elles ne respirent même pas.

sw.L: Masikio zinayo, lakini hazitegi sikio; wala hakuna pumzi vinywani mwao.
sw.B: Zina masikio, lakini hazisikii kitu; hata pumzi haimo vinywani mwao.
sw.R: Zina masikio, lakini haziwezi kusikia. Hazipumui hata kidogo.

decisions.choice: breath: the breath of life
decisions.reason: The word (ruach) is breath, wind or spirit. An idol has a mouth but no breath, no life at all (Jeremiah 10:14; Habakkuk 2:19). Psalm 115:6 says instead that they cannot smell.

decisions.choice: also there is not: not even
decisions.reason: The words (af 'en yesh) stress the denial: not even breath.

source.text: כְּ֭מוֹהֶם יִהְי֣וּ עֹשֵׂיהֶ֑ם כֹּ֭ל אֲשֶׁר־בֹּטֵ֣חַ בָּהֶֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: Like them will be those who make them, everyone who trusts in them.

en.L: Like them will be those who make them, everyone who trusts in them.
en.B: The people who make them will end up like them, and so will everyone who relies on them.
en.R: People who make idols will become as useless as the idols are, and so will everyone who trusts in them.

fr.L: Comme elles seront ceux qui les font, quiconque se confie en elles.
fr.B: Ceux qui les fabriquent finiront comme elles, et de même tous ceux qui comptent sur elles.
fr.R: Les gens qui fabriquent des idoles deviendront aussi inutiles qu’elles, et tous ceux qui ont confiance en elles aussi.

sw.L: Kama hizo watakuwa wale wanaozifanya, kila anayeziamini.
sw.B: Watu wanaozitengeneza wataishia kuwa kama hizo, vivyo hivyo kila anayezitegemea.
sw.R: Watu wanaotengeneza sanamu watakuwa bure kama sanamu hizo, vivyo hivyo kila mtu anayezitumainia.

decisions.choice: will be: a statement, or a wish
alternatives: may those who make them be like them
decisions.reason: The verb can say what will happen or what the singer wishes. As in 115:8, it is taken as a statement of what becomes of idol makers.

decisions.choice: people become like what they worship
decisions.reason: Those who trust in lifeless things become lifeless and deaf to God themselves (Isaiah 44:9-20; Jeremiah 2:5).

decisions.choice: as useless as the idols are
decisions.reason: Readable says in what way they become like the idols (m2).

source.text: בֵּ֣ית יִ֭שְׂרָאֵל בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה בֵּ֥ית אַ֝הֲרֹ֗ן בָּרֲכ֥וּ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: House of Israel, bless YHWH; house of Aaron, bless YHWH.

en.L: House of Israel, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; house of Aaron, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: People of Israel, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Family of Aaron, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!
en.R: People of Israel, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Priests of Aaron's family, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!

fr.L: Maison d’Israël, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; maison d’Aaron, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Peuple d’Israël, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Famille d’Aaron, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !
fr.R: Peuple d’Israël, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Prêtres de la famille d’Aaron, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !

sw.L: Enyi nyumba ya Israeli, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; enyi nyumba ya Haruni, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Enyi watu wa Israeli, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Enyi jamaa ya Haruni, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!
sw.R: Watu wa Israeli, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Makuhani wa ukoo wa Haruni, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!

decisions.choice: Israel, Aaron, those who fear: as in 115 and 118
decisions.reason: The same groups are called on in 115:9-11 and 118:2-4. This psalm adds the house of Levi (verse 20).

decisions.choice: house of Aaron: the priests
decisions.reason: The priests were Aaron's descendants (Exodus 28:1).

decisions.choice: bless the LORD: praise him, speak well of him
decisions.reason: When people bless God (barakh), they praise him and give him thanks; when God blesses people, he gives them good.

decisions.choice: praise
decisions.reason: Readable says "praise", the sense of blessing God (m3).

source.text: בֵּ֣ית הַ֭לֵּוִי בָּרֲכ֣וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֑ה יִֽרְאֵ֥י יְ֝הוָ֗ה בָּרֲכ֥וּ אֶת־יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: House of the Levite, bless YHWH; [those] fearing YHWH, bless YHWH.

en.L: House of the Levite, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; [you who] fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Family of Levi, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! All who fear {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, bless {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!
en.R: Levites, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}! Everyone who has deep respect for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}!

fr.L: Maison du Lévite, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; [vous qui] craignez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Famille de Lévi, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Vous tous qui craignez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, bénissez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !
fr.R: Lévites, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ! Vous tous qui honorez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} avec respect, louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} !

sw.L: Enyi nyumba ya Lawi, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; [ninyi] mnaomcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Enyi jamaa ya Lawi, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Ninyi nyote mnaomcha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mbarikini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!
sw.R: Walawi, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}! Kila mmoja anayemheshimu {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa hofu takatifu, msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}!

decisions.choice: house of the Levite: the Levites
decisions.reason: The tribe of Levi served at the temple under the priests (Numbers 3:5-9), as singers, gatekeepers and helpers (1 Chronicles 23:28-32).

decisions.choice: those who fear the LORD: his worshipers
decisions.reason: Those who fear the LORD are all who honor and obey him (15:4; 22:24). After Israel, the priests and the Levites, the call may also reach worshipers from other nations.

decisions.choice: who has deep respect for
decisions.reason: Readable gives the sense of "fear" here: reverence, not terror.

source.text: בָּ֘ר֤וּךְ יְהוָ֨ה׀מִצִּיּ֗וֹן שֹׁ֘כֵ֤ן יְֽרוּשָׁלִָ֗ם הַֽלְלוּ־יָֽהּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Blessed [be] YHWH from Zion, dwelling [in] Jerusalem. Praise Yah!

en.L: Blessed [be] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from Zion, [{{deity_pronoun:he|He}} who] dwells [in] Jerusalem. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.B: May {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} be blessed from Zion, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} who lives in Jerusalem. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!
en.R: Let praise rise to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} from Zion, to the God who lives in Jerusalem. Praise {{divine_name:the LORD|Yah}}!

fr.L: Béni [soit] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} depuis Sion, [{{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui] demeure [à] Jérusalem ! Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.B: Que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} soit béni depuis Sion, {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui habite à Jérusalem ! Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !
fr.R: Que la louange monte vers {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} depuis Sion, vers le Dieu qui habite à Jérusalem ! Louez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yah}} !

sw.L: Na abarikiwe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka Sayuni, [{{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}}] akaaye [katika] Yerusalemu. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} na abarikiwe kutoka Sayuni, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} anayeishi Yerusalemu. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!
sw.R: Sifa na zimpandie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kutoka Sayuni, Mungu anayeishi Yerusalemu. Msifuni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yah}}!

decisions.choice: from Zion: praise rising from where God lives
decisions.reason: In 134:3 the LORD blesses his people from Zion; here his people bless him from Zion. The God of all the earth (verses 5-7) has chosen to live among his people in Jerusalem (132:13-14).

decisions.choice: Praise Yah: the call Hallelu-yah
decisions.reason: As in verse 1; the psalm ends as it began.

decisions.choice: Let praise rise to
decisions.reason: Readable says what it means to bless God (verse 19).
